item.description:

  • Meshtastic at Benicia Amateur Radio Club by Jon Davis, KJ6FNQ.
  • Meshtastic pitch deck by Jon Davis, KJ6FNQ. An introduction used for presentations and in-person events such as Maker Faire.

Other regional meshes

These community guides offer useful examples of setup advice, troubleshooting, and local mesh projects. When joining BayMesh, use our recommended settings; another region’s preset or frequency slot may be different.
